description: Open a packing list against an order and return its PL-YYYY-NNNN number: the order reference, the consignee, where it ships to and the date. Free tier: 3 open at once; shipping or cancelling frees a slot.

consignee.description: Who receives the goods, as named on the order

date.description: The day the list was raised, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

duplicate_ok.description: Open it even though an OPEN list already exists on this reference. Default false

reference.description: The order this ships against, by id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, INV-2026-0007 or PO-4471

reference_kind.description: What the reference is. Inferred from the id when omitted: WO- work order, INV- invoice, Q- quote, otherwise a plain order

ship_to.description: The delivery address, printed on the slip. Omit to leave it off

name: packing_list_create
title: Open a packing list
